reviews.author: Verena
reviews.text:
I got a bamboo tattoo at Bloodline two days ago – my second tattoo there after having my full arm done about a year ago (done with a machine, not bamboo). I’m very happy with both results; the quality of the work is excellent and I would definitely recommend the studio.

I’m deducting one star for organization and communication. From the very first communication, I clearly described what I wanted (including reference photos) and was given a price estimate of 8,000–10,000 Baht. During the session, it turned out the tattoo would take much longer and I was charged for a full-day session. While I was told a higher rate for bamboo tattoos usually applies, this was not charged separately. However, due to the extended time and day rate, the final price ended up being more than double the original estimate. This was only clarified once I was already in the session.

The final price itself is fair, and I would have been willing to pay it from the start. The issue was the lack of coordination between reception and artist, and the late communication.

Also, it had been agreed that I could have small touch-ups on my previous tattoo done for free. This seemed to have been overlooked at first, and the original artist wasn’t available. Initially, I was asked to come back another day, but in the end another artist stepped in and completed it on the spot. The result is great, but again shows room for improvement in organization.

Overall: excellent artistic work, but communication and planning should be more transparent.

reviews.author: Ollie Hart
reviews.text:
After speaking with several studios across Bangkok, I knew this was the right place the moment I walked in. Tommy took the time to genuinely listen, talk me through the process, and showed a level of care and interest that I simply didn’t find elsewhere.

The price was slightly above what I had originally budgeted, but after the initial conversation, it was an easy decision to go with them. Considering the quality and the experience, it was still extremely fair compared to Western studios.

The session itself ended up being longer and tougher than expected. At one point I wasn’t fully happy with the placement, and they were incredibly accommodating, even redesigning parts of the tattoo on the spot despite the studio heading toward closing time. What impressed me most was that the artist continued well beyond closing without ever making me feel rushed. If anything, I was the one hoping he’d call it a day because it was pretty intense 😂.

Despite what must have been a very long day for him, he stayed patient and focused the entire time, taking the same care with the final lines as he did at the start. The result is an absolute masterpiece and a tattoo that means a great deal to me.

If you’re looking for the cheapest, quickest tattoo in Bangkok, there are plenty of places that can do that. But if you want real care, patience, craftsmanship, and artists who genuinely take pride in their work, this is the place to go. I honestly wouldn’t consider anywhere else in Bangkok.

reviews.author: Harold Booker Sr
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience at Bloodline Tattoo Bangkok. From the moment I walked in, the professionalism and attention to detail were immediately clear. The studio is extremely clean, well organized, and maintains the highest hygiene standards, which gave me complete confidence in the process.

The artists at Bloodline are true professionals. They took the time to listen carefully to my idea, helped refine the design, and made sure every detail was perfect before starting the tattoo. Their artistic skill, precision, and patience really show in the final result. The line work is clean, the shading is smooth, and the overall quality of the tattoo exceeded my expectations.

What impressed me the most was how comfortable and welcoming the environment was. The staff are friendly, respectful, and clearly passionate about their work. They explain the process, provide excellent aftercare guidance, and genuinely care about making sure clients leave satisfied.

If you are looking for **top-tier tattoo artistry in Bangkok**, I highly recommend Bloodline Tattoo. Their combination of talent, professionalism, and cleanliness makes them one of the best tattoo studios I have experienced. I will definitely return for future work.
